_comment: The repo's About box — description, website and topics. GitHub stores these as repo settings, not as files, so this is the source of truth for what they should be. Apply with: node .github/apply-about.mjs (needs `gh` authenticated).
description: Bộ kit để IDE agentic (Claude Code, Antigravity) tự dựng agent nội dung: crawl → viết → review gate → đăng social qua Make.com, kèm pipeline video 9:16 có giọng đọc, B-roll và ảnh chụp web. Zero dependency, env-only, MIT.
